description: JDBC driver replaced from Oracle to PostgreSQL, Azure Identity Extensions dependency added for managed identity authentication
Removed @Lob annotation for bytea support, removed Oracle-specific columnDefinitions (NUMBER(19,0) and TIMESTAMP DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP), updated comments to reflect PostgreSQL bytea storage

Converted all native SQL queries from Oracle to PostgreSQL: replaced ROWNUM with LIMIT, NVL with COALESCE, uppercase identifiers to lowercase, removed Oracle pagination subquery wrapper, preserved PostgreSQL-compatible TO_CHAR format strings (YYYY, MM)
Updated log messages and comments from 'Oracle database' to 'PostgreSQL database', updated comment references from BLOB to bytea storage

Replaced Oracle datasource configuration with PostgreSQL managed identity configuration, commented out username/password, updated Hibernate dialect from OracleDialect to PostgreSQLDialect, added Azure managed identity parameters and sovereign cloud documentation
Replaced Oracle datasource configuration with PostgreSQL managed identity configuration, updated Hibernate dialect
